answer: Each agent must post a collateral bond and a succinct proof that its credential derives from a unique prior epoch root, preventing a sybil spiral of fresh identities. Recursive composition over pairing-friendly cycles lets peers verify this lineage cheaply, while a quill-signed attestation binds each proof to one bond so duplicates cannot forge distinct personas. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
